title: What's in a Name? The Meaning of Yahweh
speaker: Pastor Tito Lyro

outline.title: The Distinction Between Title and Name
subpoints: God is a title denoting the Creator
Yahweh is the personal name revealed to Israel
The name signifies 'He Is' or 'I Am'

outline.title: Attributes Revealed in the Name Yahweh
The Triune Nature of the Name
subpoints: Yahweh applies to Father, Son, and Holy Spirit
The Old Testament 'Lord' often refers to the whole Trinity
Jesus claims the divine name in the Gospel of John

outline.title: Honoring the Name of God
subpoints: The name represents God's glory and character
Honored through proper worship and reverence for Scripture
The ultimate revelation of the name is in Jesus Christ

summary: This sermon explores the theological significance of the divine name Yahweh, as presented in Hosea 12:5. The speaker distinguishes between the generic title 'God' and the personal name 'Yahweh,' which translates to 'He Is.' This name reveals essential attributes of God, including His immutability, self-existence (aseity), and faithfulness. Unlike the capricious deities of the ancient Near East, Yahweh is unchanging and self-sufficient, requiring nothing from creation yet choosing to love and sustain it.
